page_note: Page concerns the diminishing of human lifespan across generations, mapped onto the cosmological hierarchy of months → days → hours → moments (each successive temporal authority producing offspring with shorter lifespans). The first structural unit (1-8) is dense cosmological-correspondential substrate. Units 9-16 and 30-34 are also substrate, framed by apostolic dialogue with the named "Babylonian catechumen." Editorial fatigue is high in the second half mostly because the Q&A frame thickens around segments 17-29, but the substantive questions and recaps preserve real cosmological content. The "Babylonian catechumen" naming is dialogue-frame appropriation (Mar Zaku tradition) wrapping substrate teaching about generational decline.
